title: The Most Profitable Business You Can Run From a Phone
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: a lot of trailer rental companies were not flexible with new companies.
stated_problem.speaker: Eli

idea.name: Semi-trailer sublease rental to truckers
idea.one_liner: Lease 53ft dry vans/flatbeds from big lessors on net-30 terms with no deposit, then sublease them weekly to owner-operator truckers who can't get credit or approval directly, keeping roughly a 2x markup.
idea.customer: Owner-operator truckers and new trucking companies with poor credit or no history, many Spanish-speaking, across the US
idea.offer: 53ft dry van and flatbed trailers for rent, DOT-inspected, weekly billing, flexible with new companies
idea.revenue_model: Recurring weekly rent (~$180/week) plus a $750 deposit and a 3-month minimum term; the margin is the spread over a ~$350/month lease cost

acquisition_channels.details: Basic Facebook Marketplace listings (photos, size, year, location, 'flexible with new companies'), posted in several areas and boosted; inbound messages answered by phone
Facebook/Instagram ads with still images run US-wide from a business page, about $5k/month, around 25 new clients/month; a VA followed up and closed by phone
Later on, truckers referred other truckers

ideas.delivery: Trailers are subleased from big lessors (Penske, Ryder, Premier Leasing) on net-30, triple-net-style terms with the vendor handling maintenance. Eli has contracts, holds a ghost trucker insurance policy and is named as additional insured on renters' policies. Two bilingual Upwork VAs (Venezuela, Brazil) run the ads, close deals, send documents, set up billing on Pay Simple and coordinate pickup. GPS tracking and recovery of missing trailers are needed. Eli ran it all from his phone in Colombia.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Hiring for more than 3 months to sole traders or small partnerships can count as regulated consumer hire under the Consumer Credit Act 1974, which needs FCA authorisation. UK GDPR applies to renter data and credit checks. HGV trailers need an annual DVSA test (the equivalent of a DOT inspection). Subleasing must be allowed under the head lease.

idea.name: Virtual truck dispatching
idea.one_liner: Find loads on load boards for owner-operator truckers who have free capacity, and take a cut of each load.
idea.offer: Finding and booking loads that match the driver's availability and location
idea.revenue_model: Per-load fee or percentage (~10% margin, about $80 per load)

key_quotes.quote: with the dispatching it's kind of like you're you're taking a very small margin per load because the margins are already thin.
You just call them, tell them, look, you know, I have this driver.
Yeah, you don't need a license to dispatch.

claims.claim: About $80 per matched load
claims.quote: started matching truckers with loads for about 80 bucks a pop.

claims.claim: A typical load paid around $800, with a margin of at least 10%
claims.quote: paying maybe like $800 and each load you would think that you're going to be taking at least a margin of 10%.

acquisition_channels.details: Loads found on load boards (DAT etc.), calling the shippers who posted them; how truckers were found is not stated

ideas.delivery: Fully virtual: the dispatcher takes the driver's availability, searches load boards and calls shippers to book loads
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to driver data. Any outreach to sole-trader drivers by text or DM would breach PECR, but no outreach method is described.

idea.name: Freight load brokerage
idea.one_liner: Represent shippers and find carriers for their loads, earning the spread; needs a broker licence in the US.

key_quotes.quote: You do need a license to broker loads, which means it's on the other side.

ideas.other_uk_rules: The US broker licence is an FMCSA requirement. The UK has no direct equivalent, but carrier liability and contract terms (e.g. CMR, RHA conditions) and UK GDPR apply.

idea.name: Specialised/hazmat trucking equipment rental
idea.one_liner: Apply the same lease-and-sublease model to specialised trucking equipment such as hazmat units.
idea.offer: Rental of specialised/hazmat trailers and equipment

key_quotes.quote: You can get into specialized equipment. You can get into like hazmat type of equipment.

ideas.delivery: not stated (implied sublease from lessors, as with r1)
ideas.other_uk_rules: ADR rules for dangerous-goods carriage, with tank and equipment inspection duties. Consumer Credit Act hire rules apply if hiring to sole traders.

idea.name: Small utility trailer rental
idea.one_liner: Lease and sublease 15-20ft utility trailers to people moving motorcycles and similar loads.
idea.customer: Consumers and small users needing small trailers

key_quotes.quote: Like the smaller the 20 foot trailers, 15 ft trailers. You can do this with that type of equipment.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Hire to consumers for more than 3 months can be regulated under the Consumer Credit Act. Consumer Rights Act terms apply. Renters need the right licence category to tow (B+E rules eased in 2021). UK GDPR applies.

idea.name: Mobile storage container sublease
idea.one_liner: Lease mobile storage units and sublease them to people for home projects and other uses.
idea.customer: Homeowners and others needing temporary storage

key_quotes.quote: You can lease mobile storage equipment for if people need it for home projects or if people need it for any other thing.

ideas.delivery: not stated; containers would need delivery and collection
ideas.other_uk_rules: A council highway licence or permit is needed for containers placed on the road. Consumer Rights Act terms and consumer hire rules apply.
